messages.subject: Re: export to cluster result.
parts:
To improve consistency withthe other model tabs, the Export of Cluster
now just exports the PMML. To "score" a file, go to the Evaluate tab
and select KMeans and score, then execute. Currently working on making
this work with any specified dataset.

Regards,
Graham
